summary: LTP and Quote clients on one NSE equity: the Quote client moves the subscription up (a PUT of the LTP code, a POST of 1501), and a 1105 text event (t:1_2885,110:...,119:...) arrives. The desktop reads it as the touchline its codes 110-119 are: both clients get a frame.

notes: 1105 carries the touchline codes 110-119 (families/xts/binary.rs parse_1105); it has no MessageCode and no trade time, so the frames carry no ltt.
The template web client drops it: its subscription filter compares the stored string instrument id with an int, and its adapter drops a message without MessageCode (audit appendix inherited item 4).

The desktop holds one subscription per instrument at the highest mode its clients ask for (websocket::manager), so the Quote client changes the LTP subscription into a Quote one; the web adapter subscribes each mode on its own.

deviations.reason: The web drops a 1105 text event: its client compares the stored string instrument id with an int, so no 1105 event passes its subscription filter, and its adapter drops a message without MessageCode as an unknown code. The desktop decodes the touchline its codes 110-119 carry (audit appendix, inherited item 4).
